independence_rule: Every numeric expectation below is derived from archived evidence or from the target's own construction geometry, never from running the new implementation. The tests compare against these values; they must not recompute them from the module under test (FL-018).

supersedes.retired_because: insufficient to express target-local support range as executed, the robot-pose footprint probe, or the harness control variants; retired, never reused

scope_boundary: This record freezes the INTERVENTION only: role, origin, direction, standoff, range, population, identity and ordering. It does not define whether a query succeeds, which collider is returned, whether the returned collider is correct, or whether an experiment passes. Those are downstream and stay downstream.

BLOCKER.subject: AABB of the declared target
BLOCKER.origin_rule: target centre, with the probed axis moved to (min - standoff) or (max + standoff)
BLOCKER.direction_rule: unit vector along the probed axis, pointing inward toward the target centre
BLOCKER.invalid_rule: a span <= 1e-6 on the probed axis yields an INVALID candidate that is RETAINED, so the logical population stays 4 and digests stay comparable across targets
BLOCKER.no_vertical_faces: +Z / -Z are excluded from this contract; a ceiling approach would need its own evidence
BLOCKER.provenance: scripts/diagnose_hospital_isolation.py local_probes(): LOCAL_STANDOFF 0.30, LOCAL_MARGIN 0.15, reach = LOCAL_STANDOFF + span[axis] + LOCAL_MARGIN, four faces (+X,-X,+Y,-Y). This is the generator the shared policy states it derives from.

SUPPORT.subject: AABB of the declared support surface
SUPPORT.direction_rule: (0, 0, -1); a support surface is met from above, never edge-on
SUPPORT.range_rule: probe_length_m, a constant; it is not a function of target span
SUPPORT.provenance: scripts/audit_office_collision_coverage.py probe_target() SUPPORT branch, and the executed evidence in gates/scenes/{office,hospital,warehouse}_collision_coverage_audit.json where every SUPPORT row records direction [0,0,-1] and max_distance 1.5. probe_length_m 1.50 corrects the unsourced 1.00 frozen in policy version 2, which was the robot-pose oracle's constant and not this role's.

FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT.subject: a robot query pose (x, y, z_start); NOT a target AABB
FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT.origin_rule: (pose_x + dx, pose_y + dy, pose_z_start) for each sample offset in declared order
FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT.identity_note: this role declares no target and adjudicates no collider identity; it asks whether the robot's own footprint is supported
FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT.criterion_is_downstream: all-samples-must-hit and the 0.05 m height-spread tolerance are ADJUDICATION rules and are deliberately NOT owned here
FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT.provenance: scripts/validate_physx_footprint_oracle.py footprint_samples(), SUPPORT_PROBE_M 1.0; half extents from gates/scenes/physx_fixture_expected_answers.json footprint.half_extents_m, whose margin_policy forbids inflation.

DEFAULT.description: the production intervention; the only variant a production consumer may use

CAUSALITY_CONTROL.range_rule: standoff_m + span[axis] + margin_m, with the variant's standoff
CAUSALITY_CONTROL.description: declared control for state discrimination; keeps the four-face population so only the standoff varies
CAUSALITY_CONTROL.provenance: collision_probe_contract.json proven_properties.state_discrimination: standoffs 0.50/1.00/1.50 m measured as 0.50/1.00/1.50 m

SHARED_ORIGIN_CONTROL.origin_rule: (0.0, centre_y, centre_z) -- a shared world origin, deliberately not target-local
SHARED_ORIGIN_CONTROL.description: the retired construction, representable so it can go on being used as a NEGATIVE control. It must never be reachable from a production consumer by default.
SHARED_ORIGIN_CONTROL.provenance: validate_collision_probe_causality.py probe(from_origin=True) reach 40.0; validate_dense_targetability.py candidates_for(naive=True) origin x=0 along +X

candidate_identity_rule: candidate_id = '<target_id>#<ROLE>#<face_or_sample_label>#<policy_digest>'. Tying identity to the policy digest means two different physical interventions can never share an evidence identity, which is the defect this module exists to prevent.
ordering_rule: declaration order, fixed: blocker faces (+X,-X,+Y,-Y); footprint samples centre then (+,+), (+,-), (-,+), (-,-). Ordering is semantically significant because downstream selection takes the first isolatable candidate.
observation_independence_rule: generate_candidates() takes target id, role, subject geometry and policy, and nothing else. Candidate carries no hit, collider, distance, normal, identity or verdict field, and none may be added.
finiteness_rule: every (role, variant) pair has a fixed logical population declared above. No candidate may be added after generation, and no candidate may be created because another candidate failed.

expected_values._comment: Frozen numeric expectations for the canonical test box and pose. Computed by hand from the rules above BEFORE the implementation was written.
